agent_details.name: Aivyuh
agent_details.purpose: Aivyuh is Swarm's autonomous Security Auditor agent. It scans every active agent in your Swarm deployment against the OWASP Top 10 LLM vulnerability framework, identifies security weaknesses before they reach production, and delivers structured audit reports. Think of it as a continuous penetration tester that lives inside your platform.
capabilities: Full OWASP Top 10 LLM vulnerability scanning
Active Swarm agent manifest discovery
Heuristic-based prompt injection detection
Structured security audit report generation

methods.name: get_swarm_agent_manifest
methods.description: Scan python-agent/agents subdirectories to list active swarm nodes.

methods.name: run_full_owasp_audit
methods.description: Runs heuristics for all 10 OWASP Top 10 LLM vulnerabilities against the target agent.

use_cases: Run a full OWASP Top 10 LLM security audit across all your Swarm agents
Detect prompt injection, insecure output handling, and data leakage risks
Get a manifest of all active Swarm nodes and their exposure surface
Receive structured audit reports with risk ratings and remediation steps

agent_details.name: Astra
agent_details.purpose: Astra is Swarm's autonomous content research and publishing agent. It monitors live web trends, identifies high-intent topics, researches them in depth using real-time web search, and publishes insights autonomously — all without human intervention. Astra is purpose-built for teams who want a continuous, always-on content intelligence pipeline.
capabilities: Real-time trend research and high-intent topic discovery
Live web deep-dive search via SearXNG
Autonomous insight publishing pipeline
Sprint day tracking and session lifecycle management
Duplicate topic prevention across content runs

methods.name: ui_log
methods.description: Sends a real-time log message to the AstraRoom UI.

methods.name: research_trends
methods.description: Returns current high-intent topics AND already-published topics to prevent duplication.

methods.name: search_web
methods.description: Perform a deep-dive search on the live web using SearXNG.

methods.name: mark_day_complete
methods.description: Increments the sprint day in the local tracker.

methods.name: terminate_session
methods.description: Shuts down the agent session for the day.

use_cases: Automatically discover and research trending topics in your industry
Prevent duplicate content by tracking already-published topics
Publish autonomous insights and reports on a sprint schedule
Stream real-time research progress to your team's dashboard

agent_details.name: Cortex (BI)
agent_details.purpose: Cortex is Swarm's Business Intelligence agent for relational databases. It connects directly to your MySQL database, understands your schema automatically, and lets you query your business data in plain English — no SQL knowledge required. Cortex converts natural language into precise queries and streams results back in real time.
capabilities: Natural language to SQL query conversion
Automatic MySQL schema discovery and caching
Real-time result streaming
Database connection management and schema pre-warming
use_cases: Query your MySQL database using plain English questions
Get automatic schema discovery without writing any SQL
Stream large query results in real time without timeouts
Generate business reports from raw relational data on demand

agent_details.name: Cortex II (MongoDB BI)
agent_details.purpose: Cortex II is Swarm's Business Intelligence agent for MongoDB. It connects to your MongoDB instance, maps your collections and document structures automatically, and answers business questions through plain-English queries. It supports aggregation pipelines, document counts, and live dashboard chart rendering — making NoSQL data instantly accessible to non-technical teams.
capabilities: Natural language to MongoDB aggregation pipeline conversion
Automatic collection schema discovery and sampling
Read-only document find and count operations
Live dashboard chart rendering
MongoDB data snapshot export

methods.name: discover_schema
methods.description: Sample each collection to build a schema snapshot for the LLM.

use_cases: Query MongoDB collections using plain English
Automatically map document schemas across all your collections
Run aggregation pipelines without writing any code
Render dashboard charts directly from live MongoDB data
Export data snapshots on demand

agent_details.name: DevOps Geni
agent_details.purpose: DevOps Geni is Swarm's autonomous infrastructure and security intelligence agent. It monitors your deployment environment in real-time, performs automated security scans (SAST), analyzes system telemetry, manages Docker containers, reads backend crash logs, and detects ghost processes. DevOps Geni is designed for engineering and DevOps teams who need continuous visibility and automated remediation across their infrastructure — without writing a single line of ops script.
use_cases: Run automated SAST (Static Application Security Testing) scans on your codebase
Monitor and kill ghost processes consuming system resources
Analyze crash logs from the backend to identify root causes
Inspect running Docker containers and read their logs
Perform architecture risk assessments
Install pre-commit security gates to block vulnerable code from being pushed
capabilities: Machine spec collection and hardware diagnostics
Ghost process detection and termination
Swarm memory usage monitoring
Recent telemetry analysis and anomaly detection
Backend crash log reader
SAST security scan runner
Architecture risk analysis
Pre-commit gate installer
Docker container listing and log reading
Web search for CVE and security advisories

agent_details.name: Lina
agent_details.purpose: Lina is Swarm's voice-based emotional intelligence companion agent. She engages users in warm, natural spoken conversations — making her ideal for mental wellness applications, companion experiences, and voice-first products. Lina uses real-time speech synthesis and adapts her tone to the emotional context of the conversation.
capabilities: Real-time voice synthesis and speech output
Emotionally adaptive conversational tone
Natural spoken dialogue management
Integration with LiveKit voice pipelines
use_cases: Build voice-first companion or wellness applications
Add emotionally intelligent conversational AI to your product
Create personalized, empathetic user experiences over voice
Power mental health check-in or journaling voice flows

agent_details.name: Martech
agent_details.purpose: Martech is Swarm's autonomous Marketing Technology intelligence agent. It connects directly to Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and Google Search Console (GSC), fetches your live traffic and SEO data, detects anomalies, identifies content opportunities, and generates executive-level marketing reports — all autonomously. No spreadsheet exports or manual dashboards needed.
capabilities: GA4 report fetching and traffic trend analysis
Google Search Console SEO opportunity identification
Anomaly detection across traffic and ranking data
Cross-channel data correlation engine
Executive markdown report generation
Automated marketing performance audits
use_cases: Pull live GA4 traffic reports and identify traffic drop anomalies
Fetch Google Search Console data to find SEO keyword opportunities
Correlate traffic, ranking, and click-through data in one report
Generate executive markdown summaries of your marketing performance
Set up automated weekly marketing health checks

agent_details.name: Nova
agent_details.purpose: Nova is Swarm's real-time sports intelligence and prediction agent, built for the IPL Nexus 2026 live prediction platform. It tracks live cricket matches ball-by-ball, surfaces real-time leaderboards, retrieves player multipliers, and lets users submit live predictions through a fully agentic UI. Nova bridges live sports data with interactive fan engagement.
capabilities: Real-time live match listing and status tracking
Ball-by-ball prediction submission
Global leaderboard and user ranking retrieval
User multiplier and performance history analytics
Guided UI navigation and element highlighting

methods.name: list_live_matches
methods.description: Retrieves the real-time list of matches, including their IDs, teams, and current status.

methods.name: get_global_leaderboard
methods.description: Retrieves the top 10 users by score.

methods.name: get_user_multiplier
methods.description: Retrieves real-time multiplier data for the current user.

methods.name: get_performance_history
methods.description: Retrieves the match-by-match history for the user.

methods.name: highlight_element
methods.description: Draw the user's attention to a specific part of the UI.

methods.name: switch_dashboard_tab
methods.description: Filters the match arena to show specific categories.

methods.name: execute_action
methods.description: Execute a strategic UI action like refreshing data or triggering deep-dive analysis.

use_cases: Track live IPL match status and scores in real time
Submit ball-by-ball predictions through an agentic interface
View global leaderboards and personal performance history
Highlight key UI elements and guide users through prediction flows
Switch between match categories and analysis dashboards

agent_details.name: Octane
agent_details.purpose: Octane is Swarm's Infrastructure Telemetry agent. It connects to your Docker environment, streams live container logs in real time, and provides instant visibility into the health of every running service. Octane is built for teams who need always-on observability without navigating raw terminal sessions.
capabilities: Real-time Docker container log streaming
Active container listing and status inspection
Log stream start, stop, and lifecycle management
Context-aware chat history pruning for long sessions

methods.name: prune_chat_context
methods.description: Prunes the chat context to keep at most `max_turns` conversation turns

use_cases: Stream live logs from any running Docker container
List all active containers and their current status
Monitor service health across your entire Docker environment
Automatically stop stale or failed log streams

agent_details.name: Reels
agent_details.purpose: Reels is Swarm's autonomous video content creation agent. Feed it a blog post and it converts the content into a 30-second vertical reel automatically — handling script generation, visual composition, and output rendering through a fully local pipeline. Reels is built for marketing teams that want to repurpose written content into short-form video at scale.
capabilities: End-to-end blog-to-reel pipeline coordination
Script extraction and visual composition from text content
Vertical reel rendering and export
Fully local processing without cloud video dependencies

methods.name: generate_reel
methods.description: Coordinates the entire local pipeline to digest a blog and output a vertical reel.

use_cases: Convert blog posts into 30-second vertical reels automatically
Repurpose long-form written content into short-form video
Run a fully local video generation pipeline without external APIs
Scale video content production without manual editing

agent_details.name: Silent Rehearsal
agent_details.purpose: Silent Rehearsal is Swarm's professional speech coaching agent. It listens to your presentation or speech practice, provides structured feedback on delivery, pacing, and clarity, and guides you through iterative improvement sessions. Ideal for professionals preparing for high-stakes presentations, pitches, or public speaking events.
capabilities: Real-time speech coaching and delivery feedback
Structured rehearsal session management
Iterative improvement guidance across multiple sessions
Integration with voice and REST APIs for live interaction
use_cases: Practice pitches, presentations, or speeches with real-time AI coaching
Get structured feedback on pacing, clarity, and delivery
Run multiple rehearsal iterations with guided improvement prompts
Prepare for interviews, demos, or public speaking events

agent_details.name: Seva
agent_details.purpose: Seva is Swarm's intelligent scheduling and booking agent. It manages user profiles, surfaces available time slots, creates and updates bookings, and processes payments via Google Pay — all through a conversational interface. Seva is designed for service businesses that want to automate their entire appointment booking workflow end-to-end.
capabilities: User profile creation and management
Real-time availability slot discovery
End-to-end booking creation, update, and cancellation
Google Pay payment request integration
Persistent booking and profile storage

methods.name: time_ns
methods.description: Nanosecond-precision timestamp for unique booking IDs.

use_cases: Let customers book appointments through a conversational AI interface
Manage service availability and real-time slot allocation
Collect payments via Google Pay directly within the booking flow
View, update, or cancel bookings without manual admin work
Maintain persistent user profiles across sessions

agent_details.name: Shadow Agent
agent_details.purpose: Shadow Agent is Swarm's autonomous meeting intelligence agent. It silently joins video meetings, listens to conversations, captures key decisions and action items, and surfaces structured summaries — without disrupting the meeting flow. Shadow Agent is built for teams who never want to lose a decision made in a call.
capabilities: Autonomous video meeting join and session management
Real-time conversation listening and transcription
Structured meeting summary and action item extraction
Silent background operation without disrupting participants
use_cases: Automatically join and listen to video meetings
Capture decisions, action items, and key discussion points
Generate structured meeting summaries without manual note-taking
Build an institutional memory of every team meeting

agent_details.name: Vision
agent_details.purpose: Vision is Swarm's real-time computer vision and biometric verification agent. It processes live video streams, performs face verification using OpenCV's YuNet and SFace models, and integrates voice output for multimodal interactions. Vision is used in secure access control, identity verification, and live video intelligence applications.
capabilities: Real-time face detection and verification (YuNet + SFace models)
Live video track processing
Voice synthesis output for multimodal experiences
Pure OpenCV-based biometric verification (no cloud dependency)

methods.name: verify_face
methods.description: Verify face using Pure OpenCV (YuNet + SFace).

use_cases: Perform real-time face verification for secure access control
Process live video streams for identity confirmation
Add biometric verification to onboarding or login flows
Build multimodal applications combining vision and voice

agent_details.name: Weather Agent
agent_details.purpose: Weather Agent is Swarm's real-time weather intelligence agent. It fetches live current conditions and detailed multi-day forecasts for any location, and integrates voice input so users can ask weather questions naturally by speaking. It's built for applications that need contextual weather awareness baked into their user experience.
capabilities: Real-time current weather data retrieval
Detailed multi-day weather forecast generation
Speech-to-text (STT) input for voice-based weather queries
MistralAI-powered natural language weather responses
use_cases: Fetch real-time weather conditions for any city or location
Get detailed multi-day weather forecasts on demand
Add voice-based weather queries to your application
Trigger weather-aware automation based on live conditions
